706988.t: According to Beekes, no suitable Indo-European cognates can be drawn; the traditional connection to Sanskrit शिथिर (śithirá, “loose, relaxed”) requires too many ad hoc assumptions, both phonetic and semantic.

706978.t: A vinicultural loan of Semitic origin, compare Hebrew כַּד (kad), Ugaritic 𐎋𐎄 (kd), Imperial Aramaic 𐡊𐡃 (kd), Punic 𐤊𐤃 (kd).

706979.t: From καθ’ (kath’) + ἅ (há); from κατά (katá) and the neuter plural of ὅς (hós) respectively.

706998.t: From κατα- (kata-, back, down) + ἥκω (hḗkō, “to have come, be present”).
